items.lb_3: Ben bought some noodles after basketball practice.
items.passage: On Saturday morning, Leo went to Yangmingshan with his aunt. The sky was cloudy, so they took warm jackets. They walked beside a small river and saw many birds in the trees. At noon, Leo bought rice balls and hot soup at a shop near the bus stop. He was tired, but he felt proud because he had climbed farther than last time.
